_comment: One-file witnessd config. key_file: your witness's identity — a random key made on first start (0600); keep it. state_file: the last head cosigned per log, so a restart still refuses a fork. directory + roots: the root-signed directory and the ceremony root keys — download both from https://ainra.org/net/ (directory.json, roots.json); every log's key and every revoked delegate comes from them, never from a request. On a public address the daemon refuses to start without key_file and the directory. Everything from `operator` down is SELF-DECLARED, served at GET /info with self_declared:true and verified by no one. Copy this, edit, then: witnessd 0.0.0.0:4991 witness.config.json
contact: a public issue thread — no email needed
note: Witnessing AINRA. Independent infra; not affiliated with the root operator.
